stages.name: 果てなき砂丘
stages.description: 広大な砂の世界を進む

stages.name: 星空の道

character.description: The same young adult man anime protagonist throughout this theme's entire music video: sand-blond hair tied beneath a travel scarf, deep brown eyes, with a distinct recognizable face and consistent adult proportions. They are a caravan pathfinder who knows the hidden wells between distant cities. Signature outfit: a sun-bleached linen coat, indigo scarf, layered desert robes, and wrapped boots. Unique personal keepsake or tool: a brass water compass engraved with caravan routes. Preserve the exact facial features, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, body proportions, outfit silhouette, and defining item in every scene.
consistency_rules: Keep this theme's named visual identity as one fixed protagonist across every scene.
Preserve the exact face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Maintain the signature costume, distinctive accessories, and defining personal item without random redesign.
Do not replace the lead or add another protagonist unless the lyrics explicitly require it.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in vast sand dunes, buried temple, desert oasis; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with sand gold, burnt orange, lapis blue, ivory; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by wide dune panorama, low angle walking shot, ruin reveal shot; clear subject separation and intentional negative space

camera_guidance.principle: vary shot scale and viewpoint to support the scene; avoid repeating identical framing in consecutive scenes
